name: Secuoya, Grupo de Comunicación, S.A.
summary: Secuoya, Grupo de Comunicación, S.A. creates, produces, and distributes content in Spain, Latin America, Eastern Countries, and internationally. It operates through Services, Content, Marketing and Communication, and International Segment. The company engages in outsourcing contracts, audiovisual services, audiovisual engineering, and marketing services. It also develops projects for big brands, generating new products and services. Secuoya, Grupo de Comunicación, S.A. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Tres Cantos, Spain. Secuoya, Grupo de Comunicación, S.A. is a subsidiary of Sacromonte Inversiones SA.
